 We recommend investors may apply for an IPO with Long-term Views. Investors should also look at the QIB, NII, and Retail numbers before investing.
 The BLS Polymers IPO minimum market lot is 100 shares with ₹15,000 application amount . The BLS Polymers IPO is a Mainboard IPO, and it is to be listed on BSE, NSE.
 Business Overview
 BLS Polymers is one of the leading firm that manufactures specialised polymer compounds used in wires, cables, and underground pipelines. Its product range consists of HDPE, MDPE, LLDPE, XLPE, PVC, HFFR, cable filling compounds, and adhesive coating compounds, serving a wide range of industries including power, telecommunications, railways, water, and oil and gas. 
 Its manufacturing facility is situated in Goa, equipped with 11 machines and spread across approximately 24,220 sq. metres. Moreover, BLS Polymers has its own in-house lab, a quality control team, and an ISO certification. Furthermore, the firm also designs customised products to meet the needs of the customer’s requirements. As of now, BLS Polymers serves more than 190 customers and exports its products to countries including Bangladesh, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, the USA, and Zambia.
